# Offline tests for libubertooth (no hardware needed): ctest
add_executable(test_le_recover test_le_recover.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src/ubertooth_le_recover.c)
target_include_directories(test_le_recover PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src)

# observation files generated by gen_recover_cases.py (blesim); CSA#1
# with a partial map falls back to the surveyed (true) map, as
# ubertooth-btle does after a channel survey
file(GLOB recover_cases ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/csa*.txt)
add_test(NAME le_recover COMMAND test_le_recover ${recover_cases})

add_executable(test_btle_file test_btle_file.c)
target_link_libraries(test_btle_file ubertooth)
target_include_directories(test_btle_file PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src
	${LIBUSB_INCLUDE_DIR} ${LIBBTBB_INCLUDE_DIR})

# LE_PACKET_CONT reassembly and LE_STATE printing from a synthetic dump
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
if(Python3_FOUND)
	add_test(NAME btle_reassembly COMMAND sh -c
		"${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_btle_dump.py btle.dump >/dev/null && $<TARGET_FILE:test_btle_file> btle.dump")
	set_tests_properties(btle_reassembly PROPERTIES
		PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "251 bytes.*")
endif()

# the HackRF Pro backend's LE search on a synthetic word stream (no libhackrf
# needed: the search does not use it)
add_executable(test_hackrf_le test_hackrf_le.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src/ubertooth_hackrf_le.c)
target_include_directories(test_hackrf_le PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../src)
if(Python3_FOUND)
	add_test(NAME hackrf_le COMMAND sh -c
		"${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_hle_words.py hle.u16 hle.txt && $<TARGET_FILE:test_hackrf_le> hle.u16 hle.txt 2409 80")
endif()
